verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an agentic commerce platform could plausibly let users version, review, and roll back their agent configurations, such as profiles or webhook subscriptions. Nothing in the evidence shows any versioning, review, or rollback of user automations. The dated protocol and API versions (e.g. 2026-08-25) cover the protocol spec, not user automations, and webhook subscriptions can only be changed through a partner manager.
